title: International Geophysical Year and the Antarctic no-fly zone

tellings.quote: That's when the International Geophysical Year happened, where Antarctica became a no-fly zone, and a

plain: Michels says that around 1956 and 1957, during the International Geophysical Year, a worldwide scientific effort, Antarctica became a no-fly zone. He tells it himself without naming a source, as part of a longer chain of events whose rest is cut off. He seems to offer it as a hint that something there was being kept out of view.
